purpose: Frames outside the decision-frame evaluation set, chosen to test that the scoreboard reader ABSTAINS when the count bug is hidden or replaced, and still reads it when it is visible on a cutaway. Every classification and value below was read by eye from the ffmpeg frame grab at that playback second (scripts/65_grab_broadcast_frames.py --label neg_a / neg_b, 2026-09-23). Nothing is copied from the manifest.
reviewer: Claude Code (claude-fable-5-1), in-app review of outputs/frames/neg_a_full.png, neg_b_full.png, neg_b_bug.png and track_full.png
rule: Fields absent from `readable` must be abstained (null) by a reader; fields present must be read as the given value. A non-null output on an absent field is a false read regardless of its value.
